name: Zoe the Exhibitionist
source:
Zoe has locked herself out of her house...naked. Your job is to help her make the right choices that'll lead her to clothes without being seen by too many people in a Choose-Your-Own-Adventure ENF-Themed game with over 1,700 3D Images and voice acting.

[from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2220110/Zoe_the_Exhibitionist/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Zoe把自己锁在了家门外……而且一丝不挂。在这款以女性裸体窘境为主题、由你选择冒险路线的游戏中，你要帮她作出正确的决定，在尽量不被太多人看见的情况下找到衣服。游戏包含1700余张3D图片与配音。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2220110/Zoe_the_Exhibitionist/]Steam[/url]]
